title: Advanced
lead: For tinkerers: the raw app config, feeds, webhooks and the vault. Most people only need Settings → Apps.

mcp.title: Apps config (JSON)
mcp.hintBefore: The same apps as Settings → Apps, as data/connectors.json. Secrets: write
mcp.hintAfter: , the model never sees the value.

feeds.title: Feeds
feeds.hint: New items become events (rss:name) that can wake up a routine.
feeds.name: name

share.title: Share to Pip & webhooks
share.hint: Make an iOS Shortcut “Get contents of URL” (POST, JSON) to share links and text to Pip from any app. Webhooks from other services go to the same place.

vault.title: Vault
vault.hint: API keys, passwords and app sign-ins, encrypted on this computer. They're slipped in at the last moment and hidden from everything the model sees.
